description: Epic 13 story 13.13: the server's status in its own window of the app's own bundled pages (ownwindows.rs). It reads the status, its parts and a release on its way, listens for new ones, does the tray's server actions through its buttons (pause, resume, open, logs, report a problem, settings, the update; never quit or stop), opens this machine's libraries and devices pages in the main window, and draws its own frame (its caption buttons, dragging, maximizing). Nothing else.
